content_sections.heading: About Bharathiar University
content_sections.text: Bharathiar University is a State University in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Its letterhead states that it is accredited with A++ Grade (3.63 CGPA) by NAAC and holds the 46th rank among Indian universities by MoE-NIRF.

content_sections.heading: Bharathiar University Director Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should have completed 50 years but be below 57 years at the time of notification. The age of superannuation for the post is 60 years. A Master's Degree with at least 55% of the marks or its equivalent grade of 'B' in the UGC seven (7) point scale. Candidates need one of the following: At least 15 years of experience as Assistant Professor (Sr. Scale)/Assistant Professor with eight (8) years in the Associate Professor grade, with experience in educational administration. Comparable experience in research establishment and/or other institutions of higher education. 15 years of administrative experience, of which 8 years as Deputy Registrar or an equivalent post. SC/ST category: 5% relaxation, from 55% to 50% of the marks at the Master's degree level. Ph.D. degree holders who passed their Master's Degree prior to 19th September, 1991: 5% relaxation, from 55% to 50% of the marks. Existing incumbents already in the University system: the minimum requirement of 55% shall not be insisted upon. Knowledge of Tamil to the extent of carrying official correspondence and drafting reports. Check the official notification (PDF) for the full eligibility wording for this post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: This amount covers the registration fee and the application fee. Pay it by Demand Draft drawn in favour of the Registrar, Bharathiar University, Coimbatore. The fee is non-refundable under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection procedure will be as per the decision of the Syndicate of Bharathiar University. Applicants should be prepared to come for an interview at their own cost. Anyone who attempts to canvas or influence their candidature in any manner will be disqualified. The Syndicate reserves the right to fill or not to fill up the post without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on tenure basis for 3 years in the first instance, or until the superannuation age, whichever is earlier. The selected candidate must join duty immediately and enter into an agreement with the University, in accordance with its laws, on joining the post. Pay protection in any manner will not be guaranteed to candidates in service on selection.

faq.question: Q1. What is the age limit for the Bharathiar University Director post?
faq.answer: Candidates must fall between two limits at the time of notification: 50 years completed, and below 57 years.

faq.question: Q2. Can a candidate with 50% marks in the Master's Degree apply?
faq.answer: Yes, if the candidate belongs to the SC/ST category, or holds a Ph.D. and passed the Master's Degree prior to 19th September, 1991. Both get the 5% relaxation from 55% to 50%.

faq.question: Q3. Is teaching experience compulsory?
faq.answer: No. The notice also accepts 15 years of administrative experience, of which 8 years must be as Deputy Registrar or an equivalent post, or comparable experience in a research establishment and/or other institutions of higher education.

faq.question: Q4. How many copies of the application are needed?
faq.answer: Eight copies must be submitted to the Registrar. Candidates in service who face a delay in forwarding may first send seven advance copies.

faq.question: Q5. Will an advance copy be enough for in-service candidates?
faq.answer: No. They will be considered and called for interview only if their applications are forwarded through proper channel and received in time, well in advance before the date of interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is knowledge of Tamil required?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice requires Tamil to the extent of carrying official correspondence and drafting reports.

faq.question: Q7. Will the University protect the current pay of a selected candidate?
faq.answer: Pay is as per the candidate's Primary Cadre, but pay protection in any manner is not guaranteed for candidates in service.

faq.question: Q8. Who pays for travel to the interview?
faq.answer: Applicants attend the interview at their own cost.
